entries.title: Ezra 9:1
segments: However great the judgments of God on men for their sins, or his mercy in their deliverance, they are prone to forget him, and even to repeat the sins for which they have been called to suffer.

entries.title: Ezra 9:2
segments: Marriages with the openly wicked have ever been a powerful means of public corruption, and a fruitful source of calamity to both rulers and people.

entries.title: Ezra 9:3
segments: I rent my garment; a token of great consternation and sorrow at the transgression of the people, in mingling by marriage with the idolatous nations around them.

entries.title: Ezra 9:5
segments: At the evening sacrifice; when the people assembled for evening worship.

entries.title: Ezra 9:6
segments:
Grown up unto the heavens; become exceedingly great. 
 
Ingenuous confession of sin, with hearty supplication to God for pardon, is a more sure means of relief than any application which can be made to creatures.

entries.title: Ezra 9:8
segments: A little space; from the time Zerubbabel with his company arrived at Jerusalem, to the arrival of Ezra.

entries.title: Ezra 9:9
segments: A wall in Judah; the means of defence from their enemies.

entries.title: Ezra 9:13
segments: However great the calamities which God inflicts on his people, they feel that he is righteous, and that he punishes them less than their sins deserve.

entries.title: Ezra 9:15
segments: Thou art righteous; in the punishment he had inflicted on them for their sins; and their deliverance was all of grace.
